# Problem 1

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```
The `penguins` dataset contains information on penguins from three species: Adelie, Gentoo, and Chinstrap, observed on the Torgersen, Biscoe, and Dream islands. Important variables include species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year.

The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables.

The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(
  x = bill_length_mm,
  y = flipper_length_mm,
  color = species
)) +
  geom_point()

ggsave("penguins_scatterplot.png")
```
